events.historyNote: Sensor record starts 2026-04-03; absence before that is 'unavailable', not 'never floods'.
CAUTION: installed 2026-07-30, so ~2 months of record at snapshot time. Demo must not describe this location as 'rarely floods'.
Installed 2026-04-03; neighbouring tidal sensors excluded from the rainfall replay pool.

Same-day SI neighbours (Minthorne 13.43in, Hamden, Grimsby) are tidally_influenced=Yes and were excluded; Richmond Terrace did not cross 5in that night. A 4.45in reading is a real flood under the 10mm event definition, it simply sits below the pool's >=5in line.
